newsitem.title: BRAZIL: SOY SHIPPING CONDITIONS AT KEY BRAZILIAN PORTS.
newsitem.headline: SOY SHIPPING CONDITIONS AT KEY BRAZILIAN PORTS.

text.p: The Brazilian ports of Paranagua and Santos reported the following conditions for shipping soybeans and soy products:
Vessels: Almar loading 30,000 tonnes soybeans. Litrotis loading 54,385 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, three vessels to load soymeal, two to load soybeans and three for mixed cargo (soybeans/meal).
Road: 141 trucks carrying soybeans arrived on Aug 8-10, as well as 151 trucks with soymeal and 19 trucks with vegetable oils, including soyoil. Loading: no figures available.

Vessels: Nichirin loading 29,700 tonnes soybeans. Waiting to dock, two vessels to load soybeans. At Cargill private terminal, Orleta Lwowskie loading 57,500 tonnes soymeal. Waiting to dock, one vessel to load 79,700 tonnes soymeal.
Road: 52 trucks carrying 1,395 tonnes soybeans arrived on Aug 10.
Rail: 25 wagons arrived with 1,327 tonnes soybeans.
